description: This file defines the `SerializationContext` interface, which bundles state and configuration needed for serializing data within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for writing various data types and managing serialization state, intended for internal use within the project.

classes.name: SerializationContext
classes.description: An internal interface that manages serialization state and provides methods to write various data types to a serialization buffer or stream.

methods.name: writeCachedElement
methods.description: Embeds cached data directly into the buffer; used for writing exactly one element.

methods.name: writeNull
methods.description: Serializes a null value into the context.

methods.name: writeBoolean
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value into the context.

methods.name: writeFieldName
methods.description: Sets the field name for subsequent value serialization, typically used in object contexts.
